name: local-backup
description: Create and list timestamped .tar.gz snapshots of a local folder — local-only work ChatGPT cannot perform itself.
author: LocalAnt

tools.name: local_backup_create
tools.description: Create a timestamped .tar.gz snapshot of a directory into the skill workspace (or a given output dir).

tools.name: local_backup_list
tools.description: List backup archives previously created in the workspace (or a given output dir).
